data.name: Shishpal
data.long_meaning: One who holds the universe in his hands, Shishpal is a name that signifies immense power and control over all aspects of life. seo.description_paragraph: Shishpal is a name of reverence in Hinduism, rooted in ancient traditions and spiritual significance. Its origin can be traced back to Sanskrit, where the name is believed to have derived from the words 'shishi' meaning 'peace' and 'pal' meaning 'protector'. The name holds a deep connection to the Hindu deity Vishnu, symbolizing his role as a protector and preserver of peace. Shishpal is also associated with the Hindu concept of dharma, the moral and ethical duty that guides individuals towards righteous living and self-realization. The name carries a profound resonance in Hindu culture, often bestowed upon children as a mark of respect and blessings for a peaceful and protected life.
